flagship.first_empirical_checkpoint: Verify one exact Dreyer sub-01 R1 EDF fixed header for 27 EEG, 3 EOG, 2 wrist-EMG channels, 512 Hz, and valid EDF geometry.

claims.question: Did selected BNCI EEG recover held-out protocol-condition information?
claims.strongest_statement: Across nine held-out participants, selected EEG reached 0.38349 macro balanced accuracy versus 0.25000 no-signal and 0.29668 timing-only.
claims.next_discriminator: Compare the signal against spatial, peripheral, timing, and matched derangement controls.
claims.unsupported: This does not establish cortical origin, movement intention, communication decoding, or practical utility.

claims.question: Was the BNCI information spatially specific to the selected central EEG representation?
claims.strongest_statement: The frozen selected central EEG representation was not spatially specific because posterior EEG reached 0.39236 balanced accuracy versus 0.38349.
claims.next_discriminator: Use a fresh cohort with stronger posterior, cue, EOG, and EMG controls.
claims.unsupported: The result does not prove that EEG contains no motor information; it rejects this spatial-specificity claim on this surface.

claims.question: Did selected EEG add reliable information beyond recorded EOG?
claims.strongest_statement: The EOG-plus-EEG log-loss gains were directionally positive at 0.02552 versus EOG and 0.01843 versus EOG plus deranged EEG, but missed frozen effect, consistency, and significance gates.

coordinates.attribution: increment beyond recorded EOG and matched derangement

claims.next_discriminator: Run the frozen 60-person Dreyer nuisance-controlled confirmation after source sensors are verified.
claims.unsupported: No EEG-beyond-peripheral or cortical-source claim passed.

claims.question: Did the S21 session-1 tiny CTC model show a language-decoding advantage?
claims.strongest_statement: On five frozen rows, tiny CTC improved corpus CER by 0.005814 over the prior, with uncertainty crossing zero and poor train fit.

coordinates.generalization: same person and session, held-out trials
coordinates.attribution: MEG contribution versus train-only text prior

claims.next_discriminator: Use a larger untouched evaluation only under a newly frozen, adequately powered protocol.
claims.unsupported: No language, thought, cross-person, cross-session, or real-time decoding advantage was established.

claims.question: Did the frozen S21 CTC model generalize across sessions better than no signal?
claims.strongest_statement: Across 63 session-2 rows, tiny CTC CER was 0.917949 versus 0.775458 for the no-signal prior, a 0.142491 regression.

coordinates.attribution: MEG contribution versus train-only text prior

claims.next_discriminator: Do not retune on consumed session 2; test a new mechanism on a separate development surface first.
claims.unsupported: This rejects the tested model and transfer surface, not MEG language decoding in general.

claims.question: Did the S7 nearest-centroid EEG bridge beat its train-only prior?
claims.strongest_statement: The tested nearest-centroid classifier was worse than its no-signal prior by 0.113636 exact-label accuracy.
claims.next_discriminator: Use an identified task with participant-held-out controls instead of expanding this baseline.
claims.unsupported: The bridge validates data plumbing only and does not establish a neural advantage.

claims.question: Does nuisance-residualized central EEG add held-out information beyond EOG, wrist EMG, posterior EEG, timing, and matched derangement in unseen people?
claims.strongest_statement: A 60-person target-firewalled confirmation is frozen, but no real Dreyer EDF header, signal, target, prediction, or score has been accessed.

coordinates.generalization: unseen participant within Dreyer Dataset A
coordinates.attribution: increment beyond EOG, wrist EMG, posterior EEG, timing, and derangement
coordinates.temporal_regime: sample-causal event-locked offline decision at eight seconds

claims.next_discriminator: Verify one exact sub-01 R1 EDF fixed header before any bulk acquisition.
claims.unsupported: No fresh unseen-person, EEG-beyond-peripheral, motor-cortex, or decoding-performance claim exists.

claims.question: Does communication-related EEG add information beyond synchronized eye and oral-muscle activity?
claims.strongest_statement: The project has a frozen measurement strategy and generated firewalls but no qualifying real full-control communication cohort result.

coordinates.generalization: unseen participant and independent cohort required
coordinates.attribution: increment beyond EOG and bilateral oral EMG

blockers: no operationally qualified public full-control cohort
no real synchronized EEG EOG oral-EMG execution
claims.next_discriminator: Qualify a real independent cohort or design a consented orthogonalized measurement study.
claims.unsupported: No thought, language, communication, or EEG-beyond-peripheral decoding claim is established.

claims.strongest_statement: Causal accounting and generated stream contracts exist, but end-to-end neural latency and live-device performance have not been measured.

coordinates.calibration_regime: zero or explicitly measured few-shot calibration

evidence.kind: consumed aggregate held-out score and artifact-only postmortem
evidence.summary: Nine-person BNCI scoring recovered protocol information but failed spatial specificity, calibration, participant consistency, and the registered EEG-beyond-EOG gates.
evidence.limitations: Small cohort, visually cued protocol, no wrist EMG, and no claim beyond the frozen aggregate result.

evidence.summary: Tiny CTC improved corpus CER by one edit-equivalent over the no-signal prior, with a paired interval crossing zero.
evidence.limitations: Five rows, poor fit, same person and session, noncausal typed-sentence task.

evidence.summary: The frozen tiny CTC model performed materially worse than the train-only no-signal prior on 63 session-2 rows.
evidence.limitations: One participant and one compact model; session 2 is consumed and cannot be tuned on.

evidence.summary: The nearest-centroid EEG classifier was worse than its train-only prior by 0.113636 exact-label accuracy.
evidence.limitations: One participant, compact baseline, and no cross-person or causal evaluation.

evidence.kind: preregistered fresh-cohort design and all-false gate
evidence.summary: The 60-participant R1/R2 confirmation freezes nuisance residualization, spatial and temporal controls, zero-calibration participant holds, and one score.
evidence.limitations: Generated qualification has no scientific value and no fresh Dreyer payload has been accessed.

evidence.summary: Only one narrow directional real-task item exists; peripheral-adjusted communication, independent replication, causal continuity, and live-device evidence remain absent.
evidence.limitations: The communication program is strategic and generated-only; it authorizes no metadata, payload, signal, model, score, or device operation.

experiments.scientific_question: Does nuisance-residualized central EEG add held-out information beyond EOG, wrist EMG, posterior EEG, timing, and matched derangement in unseen people?
experiments.evidence_target: A calibrated and participant-consistent incremental central-EEG effect under the frozen R1/R2 protocol.
experiments.earliest_checkpoint: One exact sub-01 R1 EDF fixed-header sensor and sampling-rate observation.
experiments.stop_rule: Park immediately if the required 27 EEG, 3 EOG, 2 wrist-EMG, 512 Hz, and EDF geometry surface is absent or ambiguous.
experiments.deserves_resources_because: It directly discriminates the neural-increment hypothesis from the strongest peripheral, visual, timing, and derangement explanations in 60 fresh people.
experiments.authority: DREYER-C5R-1-HL is exact-green and all-false; a fresh packet-bound maintainer decision is still required.
experiments.expected_information_gain: High: H0 parks a 1.78 GB acquisition before spend; H1 opens the shortest credible route to a fresh controlled score.

experiments.scientific_question: Does source-only geometry normalization recover a nuisance-specific cross-person residual EEG increment?
experiments.evidence_target: An aligned arm improves held-out source development performance without lifting posterior, timing, or deranged controls.
experiments.earliest_checkpoint: One authorized development-only grouped comparison against fixed homologous-pair residual features.
experiments.stop_rule: Stop if alignment lifts controls equally or only improves posterior EEG.
experiments.deserves_resources_because: It tests a concrete cross-person sensor-misalignment mechanism rather than increasing model capacity.
experiments.authority: Tier A design only; no data or model execution is authorized by this ledger.
experiments.expected_information_gain: Medium and conditional on a Dreyer source or LOSO failure.

experiments.scientific_question: Can the future prospective communication protocol be executed and independently verified inside its frozen resource envelope?
experiments.evidence_target: One complete generated producer transcript and an independently matching zero-model verification.
experiments.earliest_checkpoint: Reconsider only when a real communication cohort is imminent and FS3 is the last concrete blocker.
experiments.stop_rule: Do not spend another cycle while it remains detached from a real empirical decision.
experiments.deserves_resources_because: It protects a future communication score, but currently has lower scientific information gain than Dreyer.
experiments.authority: No activation or execution authority is created; prior FS2 is consumed and cannot be retried.
experiments.expected_information_gain: Low for current scientific beliefs; useful only near a real prospective execution.

experiments.scientific_question: Can an orthogonalized task separate intended communication from lateralized cues, eye movement, and oral-muscle activity?
experiments.evidence_target: A measurement design whose target remains identifiable after matched cue, gaze, EOG, and bilateral oral-EMG controls.
experiments.earliest_checkpoint: Generated identifiability simulation plus power, storage, consent, and device estimates.
experiments.stop_rule: Expire or redesign if intended output cannot be separated from cue and peripheral physiology before recruitment.
experiments.deserves_resources_because: Changing the measurement may create more scientific leverage than another model on confounded legacy tasks.
experiments.authority: Design only; no recruitment, device, private data, or human operation is authorized.
experiments.expected_information_gain: Potentially high but long-horizon and gated by measurement feasibility.
